spfsrr.title: Name a Villager
spfsrr.body:
§eTrigger

§7A Name Tag gives a Villager a new name.

§eReaction

§7The Villager takes in the new name, pleased, puzzled or a little put out.
spfsrr.speaker: villager

locuih.title: Share Food with Another Villager
locuih.body:
§eTrigger

§7A Villager throws Food to another Villager.

§eReaction

§7Friendly words while sharing a meal.
locuih.speaker: villager

zqfvby.title: Two Villagers in One Boat
zqfvby.body:
§eTrigger

§7Two Villagers sit in the same Boat.

§eReaction

§7They squabble over room, steering and rowing.
zqfvby.speaker: villager

gmrypkswxeva.title: Two Villagers Wander Together
gmrypkswxeva.body:
§eTrigger

§7Two Villagers walk together long enough to start a conversation.

§eReaction

§7One of them opens with a grumble the other has to answer.
gmrypkswxeva.speaker: villager

gmrypkbayahw.body:
§eTrigger

§7Two adult men stand together near a player for a while and start a conversation of their own. This is the second line, after one of them complains about a trade.

§eReaction

§7The friend has heard this grumbling too often and waves it off.
gmrypkbayahw.speaker: villager

gmrypkmudlec.body:
§eTrigger

§7Two adult men stand together near a player for a while and start a conversation of their own. The complainer answers the brush-off.

§eReaction

§7He is offended and takes back a small favour.
gmrypkmudlec.speaker: villager

gmrypkoallbt.body:
§eTrigger

§7Two adult men stand together near a player for a while and start a conversation of their own. This line opens it.

§eReaction

§7One villager whispers to the other to get his attention.
gmrypkoallbt.speaker: villager

gmrypkfobzlt.body:
§eTrigger

§7Two adult men stand together near a player for a while and start a conversation of their own. The second villager answers the whisper.

§eReaction

§7He asks what the secret whispering is about.
gmrypkfobzlt.speaker: villager

gmrypkcljvls.body:
§eTrigger

§7Two adult men stand together near a player for a while and start a conversation of their own. The first villager closes the exchange.

§eReaction

§7He has forgotten what he wanted to say.
gmrypkcljvls.speaker: villager

gmrypkhiqnpi.body:
§eTrigger

§7Two adult men stand together near a player for a while and start a conversation of their own. This line opens it.

§eReaction

§7A villager notes how many young animals the village has lately.
gmrypkhiqnpi.speaker: villager

gmrypkvkuidc.body:
§eTrigger

§7Two adult men stand together near a player for a while and start a conversation of their own. The second villager answers.

§eReaction

§7He agrees that the little ones are lovely to watch.
gmrypkvkuidc.speaker: villager

gmrypkhnvsiu.body:
§eTrigger

§7Two adult men stand together near a player for a while and start a conversation of their own. The first villager answers.

§eReaction

§7He jokes that he stopped his own child from growing up.
gmrypkhnvsiu.speaker: villager

gmrypkvswnrg.body:
§eTrigger

§7Two adult men stand together near a player for a while and start a conversation of their own. The second villager closes the exchange.

§eReaction

§7A dry remark about the child who never grows.
gmrypkvswnrg.speaker: villager

gmrypkmwtiaf.body:
§eTrigger

§7Two adult men stand together near a player for a while and start a conversation of their own. This line opens it.

§eReaction

§7Village news: the cartographer wants someone to carry his maps far away.
gmrypkmwtiaf.speaker: villager

gmrypkgougka.body:
§eTrigger

§7Two adult men stand together near a player for a while and start a conversation of their own. The second villager answers.

§eReaction

§7He teases his friend about volunteering for the trip.
gmrypkgougka.speaker: villager

gbxzxv.title: Unemployed Villager Wandering
gbxzxv.body:
§eTrigger

§7A Villager with no profession wanders about.

§eReaction

§7It talks about looking for a workstation and filling its idle days.
gbxzxv.speaker: villager

djpksc.title: Armorer at Work
djpksc.body:
§eTrigger

§7Watch an Armorer working at his Blast Furnace.

§eReaction

§7Talk about forging armour and the heat of the furnace.
djpksc.speaker: villager

ueczyh.title: Butcher at Work
ueczyh.body:
§eTrigger

§7A Butcher works beside their Smoker.

§eReaction

§7The Butcher talks about their meat and their trade.
ueczyh.speaker: villager

ywzhwz.title: Cannot Reach Workstation
ywzhwz.body:
§eTrigger

§7A Villager with a profession has no Workstation it can reach for a while.

§eReaction

§7Frustrated remarks about not getting to work.
ywzhwz.speaker: villager

trphsn.title: Cannot Find the Bell
trphsn.body:
§eTrigger

§7An adult Villager has gone a while without knowing where the village Bell is.

§eReaction

§7Puzzled remarks about not finding the Bell to gather at.
trphsn.speaker: villager

wuoloh.title: Cartographer at Work
wuoloh.body:
§eTrigger

§7A Cartographer works beside their Cartography Table.

§eReaction

§7The Cartographer talks about their maps.
wuoloh.speaker: villager

hkowex.title: Cleric at Work
hkowex.body:
§eTrigger

§7A Cleric works beside their Brewing Stand.

§eReaction

§7The Cleric talks about their Potions and blessings.
hkowex.speaker: villager

qawras.title: Start Work
qawras.body:
§eTrigger

§7An employed Villager reaches their job-site Block when the workday begins.

§eReaction

§7Morning chatter about getting back to work.
qawras.speaker: villager

fbuabj.title: Have a Baby
fbuabj.body:
§eTrigger

§7Two Villagers have a baby; the nearest adult greets the newborn.

§eReaction

§7The parent welcomes the baby with pride, worry and jokes about one more mouth to feed.
fbuabj.speaker: villager

klabhl.title: Refuses to Trade During a Raid
klabhl.body:
§eTrigger

§7A player tries to trade while the Villager is reacting to a Raid or raiders nearby.

§eReaction

§7The Villager has no time for trade until the danger passes.
klabhl.speaker: villager

zalmof.title: Cannot Trade
zalmof.body:
§eTrigger

§7You try to trade with a Villager who has no trades to offer.

§eReaction

§7Apologetic remarks about having nothing to sell.
zalmof.speaker: villager

lhdgsy.title: Refuses a Low-Reputation Player
lhdgsy.body:
§eTrigger

§7A player tries to trade while their Reputation with the Villager is too low.

§eReaction

§7A cold refusal that says the Villager has not forgotten.
lhdgsy.speaker: villager

nukxsf.title: Try to Trade with a Nitwit
nukxsf.body:
§eTrigger

§7Try to Trade with a Nitwit.

§eReaction

§7The Nitwit is puzzled anyone wants a deal from it at all.
nukxsf.speaker: villager

nlbhku.title: Try to Trade with an Unemployed Villager
nlbhku.body:
§eTrigger

§7Try to Trade with a Villager who has no profession yet.

§eReaction

§7It explains it has no workstation and no trade to offer.
nlbhku.speaker: villager

umdvtb.title: Farmer at Work
umdvtb.body:
§eTrigger

§7Let a Farmer work at their Composter.

§eReaction

§7The Farmer calls out about the harvest for sale.
umdvtb.speaker: villager

tgggoh.title: Fisherman at Work
tgggoh.body:
§eTrigger

§7Let a Fisherman work at their Barrel.

§eReaction

§7The Fisherman calls out about the catch.
tgggoh.speaker: villager

fzjope.title: Fletcher at Work
fzjope.body:
§eTrigger

§7Let a Fletcher work at their Fletching Table.

§eReaction

§7The Fletcher praises the arrows for sale.
fzjope.speaker: villager

ebfifz.title: Villager Gathering
ebfifz.body:
§eTrigger

§7Three or more adult Villagers stand together near a player.

§eReaction

§7One of them starts chatting with the others about village news.
ebfifz.speaker: villager

wrjbdd.title: Villagers Gossip
wrjbdd.body:
§eTrigger

§7Two Villagers stand together for a while during their gathering time.

§eReaction

§7They trade the latest village rumours in a low voice.
wrjbdd.speaker: villager

zvbnea.title: Nudge a Villager in a Boat
zvbnea.body:
§eTrigger

§7You push a boat with a Villager sitting in it.

§eReaction

§7A nervous passenger asks you to leave the boat alone.
zvbnea.speaker: villager

ybwgyt.title: Boat on Land
ybwgyt.body:
§eTrigger

§7A Villager sits in a Boat that rests on dry land.

§eReaction

§7Puzzled remarks about a Boat going nowhere.
ybwgyt.speaker: villager

tjkgmv.title: Boat on Water
tjkgmv.body:
§eTrigger

§7A Villager rides in a Boat floating on water.

§eReaction

§7Cheerful remarks about the trip across the water.
tjkgmv.speaker: villager

igyvcw.title: Sit in a Minecart
igyvcw.body:
§eTrigger

§7A Villager sits in a Minecart that is not moving.

§eReaction

§7Remarks about the seat and where the rails go.
igyvcw.speaker: villager

ifppja.title: Ride in a Moving Minecart
ifppja.body:
§eTrigger

§7A Minecart moves with a Villager riding in it.

§eReaction

§7Nervous or giddy words about the speed of the ride.
ifppja.speaker: villager

fltegg.title: Level Up
fltegg.body:
§eTrigger

§7A Villager reaches a new trading level.

§eReaction

§7The Villager celebrates new skills and new trades.
fltegg.speaker: villager

ydigbg.title: Stand Near Fire
ydigbg.body:
§eTrigger

§7A Villager stands close to Fire.

§eReaction

§7Worried remarks about the flames being far too close.
ydigbg.speaker: villager

ivumgm.title: Cure a Zombie Villager
ivumgm.body:
§eTrigger

§7Cure a Zombie Villager: Weakness, then a Golden Apple, and wait for it to turn back.

§eReaction

§7The Villager, back to itself, thanks you and gets used to being alive.
ivumgm.speaker: villager

aobqjt.title: Farming
aobqjt.body:
§eTrigger

§7Let a Farmer tend, harvest or plant crops.

§eReaction

§7The Farmer talks about the field while working.
aobqjt.speaker: villager

ioxtmt.title: Go to Bed
ioxtmt.body:
§eTrigger

§7Let a Villager reach its Bed and lie down to sleep.

§eReaction

§7The Villager says a few words before sleep.
ioxtmt.speaker: villager

tdvtmn.title: Inspect Bookshelves
tdvtmn.body:
§eTrigger

§7A Librarian stands still beside a Bookshelf.

§eReaction

§7The Librarian fusses over the order and care of the books.
tdvtmn.speaker: villager

qmpcxi.title: Name a Villager "Dinnerbone"
qmpcxi.body:
§eTrigger

§7A Name Tag names a Villager "Dinnerbone", turning them upside down.

§eReaction

§7The Villager tries to make sense of a world that has flipped over.
qmpcxi.speaker: villager

armupg.title: Name a Villager "Jeb"
armupg.body:
§eTrigger

§7A Name Tag names a Villager "Jeb".

§eReaction

§7The Villager delights in suddenly being every colour at once.
armupg.speaker: villager

kljgyu.title: Hear a Bell Ring
kljgyu.body:
§eTrigger

§7A Bell rings close enough for a Villager to hear it.

§eReaction

§7The Villager wonders why the bell is ringing.
kljgyu.speaker: villager

sdhkke.title: Stand Near a Workstation
sdhkke.body:
§eTrigger

§7An employed Villager works beside their job-site Block.

§eReaction

§7Proud chatter about their work and wares.
sdhkke.speaker: villager

asqzby.title: Sleeping
asqzby.body:
§eTrigger

§7A Villager is asleep.

§eReaction

§7Now and then the Villager talks in its sleep.
asqzby.speaker: villager

zpcnhu.title: Stand on Ice
zpcnhu.body:
§eTrigger

§7A Villager stands on Ice.

§eReaction

§7Careful, wobbly remarks about the slippery ground.
zpcnhu.speaker: villager

wancdi.title: Stand on Magma
wancdi.body:
§eTrigger

§7A Villager stands on a Magma Block.

§eReaction

§7Yelps about the burning floor and scorched boots.
wancdi.speaker: villager

lvigit.title: Villager Wandering
lvigit.body:
§eTrigger

§7A Villager wanders about on its usual day.

§eReaction

§7Idle thoughts about the village, the weather and its own plans.
lvigit.speaker: villager

ycynep.title: Wander in Another Dimension
ycynep.body:
§eTrigger

§7A Villager wanders in a dimension that is not the Overworld, the Nether or the End.

§eReaction

§7Puzzled remarks about a place that feels nothing like home.
ycynep.speaker: villager

wwcbib.title: Wander in the End
wwcbib.body:
§eTrigger

§7A Villager wanders in the End.

§eReaction

§7Nervous remarks about the strange floating land and what flies above it.
wwcbib.speaker: villager

zpjrtq.title: Wander in the Nether
zpjrtq.body:
§eTrigger

§7A Villager wanders in the Nether.

§eReaction

§7Complaints about the heat and the rivers of fire.
zpjrtq.speaker: villager

ljewqf.title: Leatherworker at Work
ljewqf.body:
§eTrigger

§7A Leatherworker works beside their Cauldron.

§eReaction

§7Shop talk about hides, stitching and dyed leather goods.
ljewqf.speaker: villager

fezzjw.title: Librarian at Work
fezzjw.body:
§eTrigger

§7A Librarian works beside their Lectern.

§eReaction

§7Book-loving shop talk at the Lectern.
fezzjw.speaker: villager

yldlzt.title: Mason at Work
yldlzt.body:
§eTrigger

§7A Mason works beside their Stonecutter.

§eReaction

§7Proud shop talk about cut stone and building.
yldlzt.speaker: villager

uookqp.title: Nitwit Wandering
uookqp.body:
§eTrigger

§7A Nitwit wanders about with nothing to do.

§eReaction

§7Odd thoughts and idle musings of the village Nitwit.
uookqp.speaker: villager

vgysma.title: Open a Chest
vgysma.body:
§eTrigger

§7You open a Chest near a Villager.

§eReaction

§7Nosy remarks about what you are digging through.
vgysma.speaker: villager

uzdxum.title: Villager Panics
uzdxum.body:
§eTrigger

§7A Villager starts to panic because of danger nearby.

§eReaction

§7Frightened shouts as it runs for safety.
uzdxum.speaker: villager

dxmmiu.title: Pick Up an Item
dxmmiu.body:
§eTrigger

§7A Villager picks up an Item lying on the ground.

§eReaction

§7Pleased remarks about the find.
dxmmiu.speaker: villager

vkhrme.title: Pick Up an Item Dropped by a Player
vkhrme.body:
§eTrigger

§7A Villager picks up an Item that you dropped.

§eReaction

§7Thanks, or a cheeky claim to the Item.
vkhrme.speaker: villager

ujyxfg.title: Pick Up an Item Dropped by a Villager
ujyxfg.body:
§eTrigger

§7A Villager picks up an Item another Villager dropped.

§eReaction

§7Words to the neighbour who lost it.
ujyxfg.speaker: villager

zjwpzi.title: Pick Up Armor
zjwpzi.body:
§eTrigger

§7A Villager picks up a piece of Armor.

§eReaction

§7What a Villager, who cannot wear it, would do with Armor.
zjwpzi.speaker: villager

habfnx.title: Pick Up Enchanted Armor
habfnx.body:
§eTrigger

§7A Villager picks up an enchanted piece of Armor.

§eReaction

§7Wonder at the glowing, humming Armor.
habfnx.speaker: villager

czvvwy.title: Close Trading After Buying
czvvwy.body:
§eTrigger

§7You close a Villager's trading window after at least one trade.

§eReaction

§7Pleased goodbyes after a good sale.
czvvwy.speaker: villager

lilimm.title: Close Trading Without Buying
lilimm.body:
§eTrigger

§7You close a Villager's trading window without trading.

§eReaction

§7Disappointed remarks about losing a sale.
lilimm.speaker: villager

pnvkfy.title: Reach Master Level
pnvkfy.body:
§eTrigger

§7A villager reaches the Master trading level.

§eReaction

§7The villager is proud and thanks the player.
pnvkfy.speaker: villager

rlfjux.title: Receive Beetroot
rlfjux.body:
§eTrigger

§7A player gives a villager Beetroot.

§eReaction

§7The villager thanks the player and thinks of soup.
rlfjux.speaker: villager

bbjsik.title: Receive Bread
bbjsik.body:
§eTrigger

§7A player gives a villager Bread.

§eReaction

§7The villager happily takes it for a meal.
bbjsik.speaker: villager

nqktml.title: Receive Carrot
nqktml.body:
§eTrigger

§7A player gives a villager a Carrot.

§eReaction

§7The villager thanks the player for the fresh carrot.
nqktml.speaker: villager

ebyrtk.title: Receive Food
ebyrtk.body:
§eTrigger

§7A player gives a grown Villager some Food.

§eReaction

§7Thanks for the gift, with a word about how good it looks.
ebyrtk.speaker: villager

ytydjc.title: Receive Potatoes
ytydjc.body:
§eTrigger

§7A player gives a Villager Potatoes.

§eReaction

§7Happy words about what the potato will become.
ytydjc.speaker: villager

wkfbuv.title: Return Home
wkfbuv.body:
§eTrigger

§7Evening comes and a Villager with a home heads back to it.

§eReaction

§7Tired end-of-day words on the way home.
wkfbuv.speaker: villager

uhbigm.title: Return Home in Another Dimension
uhbigm.body:
§eTrigger

§7Evening comes while a Villager is in a dimension other than the Overworld, the Nether or the End.

§eReaction

§7Puzzled words about when to sleep so far from home.
uhbigm.speaker: villager

iubjul.title: Try to Return Home in the End
iubjul.body:
§eTrigger

§7A Villager in the End reaches the time it would go home.

§eReaction

§7Homesick remarks about being far from bed and village.
iubjul.speaker: villager

bvtmmz.title: Try to Return Home in the Nether
bvtmmz.body:
§eTrigger

§7A Villager is in the Nether when evening comes and its day would send it home.

§eReaction

§7It wonders where anyone sleeps under a sky of lava, and how far away home is.
bvtmmz.speaker: villager

uqguqj.title: Return Home Without a Bed
uqguqj.body:
§eTrigger

§7Evening comes and a Villager heads home with no Bed to sleep in.

§eReaction

§7Grumbling about having a home but nowhere to lie down.
uqguqj.speaker: villager

pbmrxx.title: See a Baby Villager
pbmrxx.body:
§eTrigger

§7A grown Villager is near a Baby Villager.

§eReaction

§7A fond word about the little one.
pbmrxx.speaker: villager

qltnkz.title: Baby Zombie Piglin
qltnkz.body:
§eTrigger

§7Bring a baby Zombie Piglin near a villager.

§eReaction

§7Alarm at the armed little Piglin and a warning not to hit it.
qltnkz.speaker: villager

nstwos.title: Baby Zombie Villager
nstwos.body:
§eTrigger

§7Bring a baby Zombie Villager near a villager.

§eReaction

§7Sorrow and the hope of curing the child.
nstwos.speaker: villager

gtmfpl.title: Spider
gtmfpl.body:
§eTrigger

§7A Spider or Cave Spider comes within sight of a Villager.

§eReaction

§7Nervous remarks about the eight-legged visitor.
gtmfpl.speaker: villager

xtooxu.title: Zombie Villager
xtooxu.body:
§eTrigger

§7A Zombie Villager comes near a Villager.

§eReaction

§7Sad and worried reactions to a neighbour lost to the sickness, and hope of a cure.
xtooxu.speaker: villager

pkvhpv.title: See Another Entity Get Hurt
pkvhpv.body:
§eTrigger

§7Another creature near a Villager takes damage.

§eReaction

§7A wince and a word of sympathy.
pkvhpv.speaker: villager

zejman.title: Break a Block
zejman.body:
§eTrigger

§7You break a Block while a Villager watches.

§eReaction

§7Surprised remarks about the Block you just took.
zejman.speaker: villager

nwkgqg.title: Hold a Nearly Broken Item
nwkgqg.body:
§eTrigger

§7A player holds an item that is almost worn out.

§eReaction

§7Worried advice to mend the item before it breaks.
nwkgqg.speaker: villager

qfhrlh.title: Open a Chest in a Villager's House
qfhrlh.body:
§eTrigger

§7You open a Chest inside a Villager's home while its owner sees you.

§eReaction

§7The owner angrily tells you to keep out of their things.
qfhrlh.speaker: villager

rtmqmc.title: Place a Button
rtmqmc.body:
§eTrigger

§7You place a Button near a Villager.

§eReaction

§7Curiosity about what the Button does.
rtmqmc.speaker: villager

adtdit.title: Place a Daylight Detector
adtdit.body:
§eTrigger

§7You place a Daylight Detector near a Villager.

§eReaction

§7Wonder at a Block that watches the sun.
adtdit.speaker: villager

edjqet.title: Place a Detector Rail
edjqet.body:
§eTrigger

§7You place a Detector Rail near a Villager.

§eReaction

§7Remarks about the rail and the carts on it.
edjqet.speaker: villager

ntnicx.title: Place a Lightning Rod
ntnicx.body:
§eTrigger

§7A player places a Lightning Rod near a villager.

§eReaction

§7The villager remembers storms and gets a little nervous about lightning.
ntnicx.speaker: villager

veaotb.title: Place a Melon
veaotb.body:
§eTrigger

§7A player places a Melon near a villager.

§eReaction

§7The villager looks forward to sharing it out.
veaotb.speaker: villager

nwiopk.title: Place an Observer
nwiopk.body:
§eTrigger

§7A player places an Observer near a villager.

§eReaction

§7The villager feels watched by the block and acts accordingly.
nwiopk.speaker: villager

jggged.title: Place a Pressure Plate
jggged.body:
§eTrigger

§7A player places a Pressure Plate near a villager.

§eReaction

§7The villager is wary of stepping on it or guesses what it opens.
jggged.speaker: villager

ydfscf.title: Place a Pumpkin
ydfscf.body:
§eTrigger

§7A player places a Pumpkin near a villager.

§eReaction

§7The villager thinks of pie, golems and how big it grew.
ydfscf.speaker: villager

qbuuop.title: Place Redstone Dust
qbuuop.body:
§eTrigger

§7A player lays Redstone Dust on a block near a villager.

§eReaction

§7The villager is curious about the red lines on the ground.
qbuuop.speaker: villager

hlxzen.title: Place a Redstone Lamp
hlxzen.body:
§eTrigger

§7A player places a Redstone Lamp near a villager.

§eReaction

§7The villager likes the glow, or wonders why the lamp stays dark.
hlxzen.speaker: villager

cdltxm.title: Place a Redstone Repeater
cdltxm.body:
§eTrigger

§7A player places a Redstone Repeater near a villager.

§eReaction

§7The villager studies the tiny torches and the clicking.
cdltxm.speaker: villager

wsjvjd.title: Place a Sculk Sensor
wsjvjd.body:
§eTrigger

§7A player places a Sculk Sensor near a villager.

§eReaction

§7The villager grows uneasy about a thing that listens.
wsjvjd.speaker: villager

jtsycy.title: Place a Trapped Chest
jtsycy.body:
§eTrigger

§7A player places a Trapped Chest near a villager.

§eReaction

§7The villager spots the trick and refuses to fall for it.
jtsycy.speaker: villager

wwmhos.title: Place a Tripwire Hook
wwmhos.body:
§eTrigger

§7A player places a Tripwire Hook near a villager.

§eReaction

§7The villager worries about tripping on the snare.
wwmhos.speaker: villager

ujkoue.title: Place a Workstation
ujkoue.body:
§eTrigger

§7A player places a villager workstation near a villager.

§eReaction

§7The villager guesses who will get the new trade, and whether it should be them.
ujkoue.speaker: villager

pizztd.title: Trample Crops
pizztd.body:
§eTrigger

§7Jump on Farmland and trample it back into Dirt near a Villager.

§eReaction

§7Upset complaints about the ruined field.
pizztd.speaker: villager

kcbenk.title: Extremely High Reputation
kcbenk.body:
§eTrigger

§7Approach a Villager while your Reputation in that village is extremely high.

§eReaction
